posts.caption:
Satisfying 50/50 paint correction on this R35 GTR. 

Paint correction is a term often used by detailers but not everyone understands exactly what this means.

Essentially over time, your car’s paintwork can develop swirl marks, fine scratches and hazing from everyday washing and use. These defects reduce the paint’s clarity, making it look dull and less glossy.

Paint correction involves the use of specialist machine polishers paired with carefully selected polishing pad and compound combinations to carefully refine the paintwork, reducing these imperfections and restoring a deeper colour, sharper reflections and a much glossier finish. 

The result is paintwork that looks cleaner, sharper and closer to the day it rolled out of the factory.
